failures_and_repairs.item: First draft of tests/scenarios.py imported a nonexistent helper (provider_task_ids) and contained an unreachable comprehension.
failures_and_repairs.repair: Removed the bad import and the dead code before any recorded run.
failures_and_repairs.impact_on_results: none; no result was recorded from the broken draft

failures_and_repairs.item: The first determinism comparison was an ad-hoc shell heredoc that crashed on a boolean observation.
failures_and_repairs.repair: Replaced with the durable tool tools/check_determinism.py, which strips run-varying fields explicitly and returns a nonzero exit code on divergence.
failures_and_repairs.impact_on_results: none; the crash produced no recorded result

failures_and_repairs.item: tools/check_determinism.py initially reported NONDETERMINISTIC on two capsule digests.
failures_and_repairs.repair: Investigated rather than suppressed: the digests hash a creation timestamp and the sandbox's own commit SHA, so they vary by construction. They are now excluded with a recorded rationale, and ledger self-consistency is asserted separately through chain_errors.
failures_and_repairs.impact_on_results: determinism is asserted over fault behaviour, not over those two digests; recorded as limitation L6

failures_and_repairs.repair: Off-by-direction bug: the Git log lineage is newest-first, so revisions after the declared one precede it in the list. Corrected to 3, which matches the four-revision lineage.
failures_and_repairs.impact_on_results: corrected before the artifact was committed
